name: QTT Payment Gateway Config
description: Platform config, not tenant data — one row per payment gateway integration (razorpay, stripe, ...). System-Manager-only; key_secret/webhook_secret are never returned by any REST response (Password fieldtype). Mirrors QTT AI Provider's shape deliberately — same trust boundary, same pattern.

fields.label: Gateway Key
fields.description: e.g. 'razorpay' — matches the gateway adapter class's own gateway_key constant.

fields.label: Mode
fields.description: Descriptive/tracking only (SaaS lifecycle Phase C) — Razorpay's API determines test-vs-live purely from which key pair (key_id/key_secret) is used, not from a separate endpoint, so nothing in the gateway adapter branches on this field. It exists so an admin UI can show a 'TEST MODE' indicator and so switching to live is a deliberate, visible action rather than inferred from which keys happen to be pasted in.

fields.label: Key ID
fields.description: Public API key/identifier — not secret, but still only exposed to System Manager here for simplicity.

fields.label: Webhook Secret
fields.description: Used to verify inbound webhook signatures — see billing/webhooks.py.
